description: A single entry in a TmScrollSpyNav. Intentionally minimal and generic: hosts that need badges, status dots, or required markers should supply a custom ItemTemplate rather than extend this record with domain-specific fields.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identifier. Must match the id attribute of the corresponding in-page section.

members.name: Label
members.description: Display text shown by the default item rendering.

members.name: IsVisible
members.description: When false, the item is excluded from the rendered list. Defaults to true.

members.name: Order
members.description: Sort order among visible items (ascending). Defaults to 0.
